name: Aeronautics Department
tagline: Everything that flies within the atmosphere.
description: The Aeronautics Department introduces students to aviation through accessible and engaging activities. Members discover aircraft design, aerodynamics, flight operations and aviation technologies through workshops, conferences, documentaries and interactive learning experiences.

name: Aerospace Department
tagline: From the edge of the atmosphere to orbit.
description: The Aerospace Department looks beyond the sky. The Aerospace Department introduces students to astronomy and space exploration through observation nights with the club telescope, Space Day, conferences, documentaries, educational games and interactive workshops. Members discover space science in an accessible and engaging way while sharing their passion for the universe.
